question: Your customer support resolution agent runs an agentic loop with the Claude Agent SDK. A customer asks for a refund, and Claude requests lookup_order, which the loop code runs correctly and saves to an audit log for the support team. However, each next request holds only the customer's messages and Claude's earlier responses. Logs show that Claude keeps requesting lookup_order for the same order and never calls process_refund. Which change fixes this behavior?

options.text: Call escalate_to_human automatically whenever Claude requests lookup_order twice for the same order, so that a human agent completes the refund.
options.reason: This hides the symptom and hurts first-contact resolution. The root cause is that the loop does not append the tool result to the conversation history.

options.text: Add few-shot examples to the system prompt that show Claude how to move from lookup_order to process_refund in refund requests.
options.reason: Few-shot examples do not supply the missing order data. Claude still cannot see the lookup_order result, so it cannot use that result in its next decision.

options.text: Rewrite the lookup_order tool description so that it explains each field in the returned order record in more detail.
options.reason: A better tool description does not help when the order record never reaches Claude, because the loop does not append the tool result to the conversation history.

options.text: Append Claude's tool_use response and the lookup_order output as a tool result to the conversation history before the next request.
options.reason: Claude can reason about the next action only when the tool result is appended to the conversation history. With the order data in context, Claude can move on to process_refund.
